bio: Dakota Degenhardt First-Year Social Committee Ivy Yard ​​Hey Class of 2026! My name is Dakota Degenhardt and I'm from Miami, Florida, currently living in Straus! I plan on concentrating in Human Evolutionary Biology on the Pre-Med track with a possible secondary in Economics or Theater, Dance and Media. I'm so excited to be a part of FYSC this year and plan many fun events for our class! Outside of FYSC, I enjoy playing for the club basketball team, participating in fashion shows, volunteering with Friends of Project Sunshine and spending time with friends! I love meeting new people so feel free to reach out to chat or if you have any ideas for future events!
